author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want to generate AI videos for free, directly on your own PC? In this video, I’ll show you how to run powerful open-source AI video models locally, with no subscriptions, no usage limits, and full privacy.

We’ll walk step-by-step through installing Pinokio, a one-click installer that makes running AI tools easy and then use Wan2GP to generate videos using models like LTX-2 and Wan. These models don’t just create video, they can also generate audio, sound effects, and narration alongside your clips.

You’ll learn:
- What hardware you need (and how much VRAM really matters)
- How to install everything with just a few clicks
- How to generate videos from text prompts or images
- How long generation actually takes on a consumer GPU
- Where all your generated videos are stored locally

If you want cloud-quality AI video generation without cloud costs, this is one of the best setups you can run today.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
